task: [.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml] .github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml iş akışındaki %50 (6/12) başarısızlık oranını düşürmek ve derleme darboğazını çözmek için; bağımlılık kurulum adımlarında `actions/cache` ile paket önbellekleme kullanılması, aynı PR/dal üzerindeki çakışan veya eski koşuları iptal eden `concurrency` bloğunun eklenmesi, uzun süren kararsız adımlara `timeout-minutes: 10` sınırlaması getirilmesi ve ağ/test bağımlılığı olan flaky adımlara `nick-fields/retry` veya `retry` aksiyonu eklenerek otomatik yeniden deneme mekanizmasının devreye alınması gerekmektedir.

evidence.details: Target workflow file `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` identified for optimization to resolve the 50% (6/12) failure rate and build bottleneck.

factual_findings: Workflow `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` lacks a top-level or job-level `concurrency` configuration, leading to redundant parallel execution on same-ref PRs and branches.
Dependency installation steps in `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` do not leverage `actions/cache`, causing repeated full package downloads and extended build times.
Unbound job/step execution times in `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` risk lingering runner allocation without explicit `timeout-minutes: 10` limits.
Network requests and test steps in `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` lack automatic retry logic (e.g., `nick-fields/retry`), contributing directly to transient step failures.
hypotheses: Configuring a `concurrency` block with `cancel-in-progress: true` using `${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}` will eliminate outdated run resource contention.
Integrating `actions/cache` for package dependencies will shorten installation step duration and reduce network-based fetch failures.
Setting `timeout-minutes: 10` on volatile steps/jobs will enforce deterministic bound times and prevent hung processes.
Wrapping network-heavy or flaky execution steps with `nick-fields/retry` will substantially reduce transient failures and improve overall workflow stability.
result.recommendation: Update `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` to include top-level concurrency control (`group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}`, `cancel-in-progress: true`), implement `actions/cache` in the dependency setup step, enforce `timeout-minutes: 10` on execution jobs/steps, and wrap network-dependent actions using `nick-fields/retry`.
result.next_action: Apply the updates to `.github/workflows/takipci-denetci.yml` with concurrency, caching, timeouts, and retry logic, then run a test workflow execution to verify failure rate reduction.
